claim_text: Alien encounters coming as a great deception used to explain away millions of people disappearing in the rapture, with the world told they were taken or vaporised for rebellion, and he points to recent sightings over Miami and New York as the build-up.
quote: Trying to explain away to the world what happened to millions
falsify_match: A public disappearance event attributed to non-human intervention.
falsify_miss: No such event. The claim only becomes testable after the rapture, which places it beyond checking by design.

claim_text: Prayer that the Canadian vote on the 28th be too big to rig, a landslide like a red wave, with corrupt politicians exposed and Canadians saying they are done with the way things have gone.
quote: It will be a landslide victory
falsify_match: A Conservative landslide on 28 April 2025.
falsify_miss: The Liberals won a fourth term on 28 April 2025. Framed as a petition rather than a prediction, but the date and the outcome are both named.

claim_text: Prayer that Satan will not have South Korea or make it a communist country, extended over Taiwan, China, the Philippines, Africa, South America, Brazil and Venezuela, with a harvest too large to count in a day.
quote: You will not have South Korea
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition, and it prays against his own South Korea vision.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: Prayer for one last harvest and an awakening from coast to coast, and that no major war break out in the Middle East no matter how much he has seen war coming, with Iran surrendering its nuclear weapons.
quote: no matter how much I've seen war breaking out
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition against his own visions.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though he states plainly here that he is praying against what he has seen, which is the pattern that makes the war material unfalsifiable.

claim_text: The mark removing free will so that people could not riot or steal and were made peaceful, then the third temple seen already built in Israel with stone columns and scrolling, and a man with a salt and pepper beard where he had been clean shaven, showing time had passed.
quote: I see uh the third temple that's going to be built soon
falsify_match: Construction of a third temple.
falsify_miss: No construction. The aged beard is his own dating device, indicating years rather than months.

claim_text: The bearded man identified as someone in Saudi Arabia, with what he believes is the pope on one side dressed in white and another spiritual leader called Noah on the other, and lightning striking above his head as he professes to be Lord.
quote: whenever he started professing that he was Lord
falsify_match: A Saudi figure claiming divinity flanked by the pope and a third religious leader.
falsify_miss: No such scene. He hedges the pope identification and asks not to have egg thrown at him, and the third figure's name he cannot place.

claim_text: Taken to the edge of heaven and shown the coming revival as lights all over the globe, thickest as rivers of light through China, the Koreas, Vietnam and Asia, with Jesus's eyes filling with tears as he points at China.
quote: there was rivers of lights in China and throughout Asia
falsify_match: Conversion movements concentrated in China and southeast Asia at unusual scale.
falsify_miss: No measurable change. Rivers of light rather than scattered points is the distinguishing detail, since it puts Asia ahead of America.

claim_text: Canada's government seen turning its back with black on their backside, as the American government and the Democrats did.
quote: there's black on the backside of the government
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event; a verdict on a government.
falsify_miss: Not checkable.

claim_text: The people being fed bread that is stale, old and cold, with the liberal so easily dealt with in the spirit if the church took its authority, and the enemy having wrecked havoc because they shrank back.
quote: fed bread that is stale and old, that is cold
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. It places the outcome on whether the church acts, which makes any result explicable.

claim_text: A changing of the guard in which those who blocked the flow are set aside and new Davids are raised up, which is what restores Canada, conditional on the sons and daughters taking dominion.
quote: you will see a cla a changing of the guard
falsify_match: A visible generational turnover in Canadian church leadership with growth following.
falsify_miss: No turnover. The condition means failure is attributed to the church rather than the word.

claim_text: He is told it is a church problem and not a government problem, seen from Maine down the eastern seaboard where religion has set in and stopped the flow so that demonic spirits took over, with a reprieve and a window given to change.
quote: It's not a government problem. This is a church problem
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event.
falsify_miss: Not checkable, and it is the standing diagnosis he returns to.

claim_text: A great fountain flowing from the Gulf of America up the I-35 corridor as the greatest revival, for the ones who say yes, extending from sea to shining sea and around the world.
quote: a great fountain that flows through
falsify_match: Revival concentrated along the I-35 corridor.
falsify_miss: No such concentration. The corridor runs through his own state, which is worth noting alongside the Tulsa and Branson material.

claim_text: The outpouring extended to Africa, Asia, Europe, South America and Australia, with all hands on deck and anyone who will be a yielded yes, since the harvest is plentiful and the labourers few.
quote: I'm looking for the people who will just say yes
falsify_match: Simultaneous movements across the named continents.
falsify_miss: No such movement, which under the yielded yes condition is attributed to people not saying yes.

claim_text: Believing for a million men and women in a prayer army who will pray and seek God's face, so that Canada is saved and the backbone of the church rises.
quote: We're believing for a million
falsify_match: A million people praying daily with the channel.
falsify_miss: Viewing figures stay in the tens of thousands. This is one of the few numbers about his own operation that could be checked.

claim_text: Major earthquakes beginning, not small ones, happening in the sea with the seabed opening and gases coming up, and deep-water fish never seen before dying and washing up or fleeing to shallower water as the sign that it is happening.
quote: signs of fish that we've never seen before dying
falsify_match: Deep-sea species appearing at the surface before major submarine earthquakes.
falsify_miss: Deep-sea fish strandings occur and have no established predictive relation to earthquakes; the folklore link has been studied and not supported. This is the earliest statement of the fish-as-sign mechanism on file.

claim_text: A major earthquake in Italy with a tsunami wave washing in, alongside the Alaskan and Japanese tsunamis, which he says is not man-made but the earth groaning in birth pains.
quote: a major earthquake taking place in Italy and washing in a tsunami
falsify_match: A destructive Italian earthquake with a Mediterranean tsunami.
falsify_miss: No such event. He separates this explicitly from the man-made material, which is a distinction he does not usually draw.

claim_text: He states he has seen the United States striking Iran and Israel striking Iran, bringing on greater anti-semitism than America has seen, with protests over the lives taken, and a major escalation with Turkey standing alongside Syria as a big brother.
quote: I've seen the United States of America striking Iran
falsify_match: Both countries striking Iran after 30 March 2025.
falsify_miss: Neither strikes. This is the earliest telling on file of both countries striking Iran, eleven weeks before Israel did and twelve before America did, and it gives no date.

claim_text: Teaching that being out of sync with the Holy Spirit can put a person in the wrong place at the wrong time and cost them their life, while those who follow closely are always protected.
quote: you could go in the wrong place at the wrong time
falsify_match: Not applicable; instruction.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though it places responsibility for surviving the coming events on the listener's attentiveness.

claim_text: Teaching on speaking in tongues, recommending a Hagin book and explaining that the speaker must make the sound rather than waiting to be moved.
quote: You got to put your boat into motion
falsify_match: Not applicable; instruction.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: Prayer over the new Canadian prime minister and that the righteous get out and vote, with an admission that he is not familiar with the Canadian political system.
quote: I'm not familiar with their politics
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though the admission is worth recording alongside the confident Canadian claims.

claim_text: He says Trudeau was prayed out of office and that the devil tried to raise up another one, and that Canadians must raise their voice so they do not get someone worse, with glory from coast to coast there.
quote: We got Justin Trudeau out of there and we prayed him out
falsify_match: Not checkable: a causal claim about prayer and a resignation.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. Trudeau resigned on 6 January 2025 under caucus pressure, which is the ordinary explanation available.

claim_text: The same spirit trying to move from Canada across to England and over Europe, with a changing of the tide so that it will be a Holy Ghost time rather than a World War time like the second war.
quote: This will be a Holy Ghost time, not a World War time
falsify_match: No general European war, with revival instead.
falsify_miss: A European war. He prays it away in the same breath as seeing it, which is the pattern throughout.

claim_text: He states it is not just about America or Canada but about England too, with the spirit trying to go over Europe, and says it will not do this.
quote: It's about England. It's going to come across
falsify_match: Parallel crises across the English-speaking countries.
falsify_miss: Nothing distinguishes them. This is the earliest telling of the three-country framing on file, two months before the flags version.

claim_text: The economy of Canada seen as brown whiskey barrels and as darkness, which he says he does not understand because Canadians do not use barrels like that.
quote: I see the economy of Canada like like barrels
falsify_match: A Canadian economic downturn.
falsify_miss: No downturn. The barrels recur a month later attached to trade, and he says here he cannot interpret them.

claim_text: The barrels repeated, with the Canadian economy described as bad and covered in darkness.
quote: the economy of Canada. I see it almost like as darkness
falsify_match: A Canadian recession or worse.
falsify_miss: Ordinary conditions. Darkness over an economy is not a measurable state.

claim_text: Vancouver seen lit up with finances and smarter leadership, wanting to secede and separate from Canada and line up more with America.
quote: almost like they want to succeed
falsify_match: A separation movement in British Columbia aimed at joining America.
falsify_miss: No such movement. This is the earliest telling on file, and the motive here is finance and leadership rather than the earthquake or the digital platform he gives later.

claim_text: Darkness thick as molasses coming down over Canada in the shape of a pyramid centred on Toronto in Ontario rather than Quebec, spreading outward, while Vancouver stands in light and fights it.
quote: It's the pyramid of darkness
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event; a spiritual map of Canada.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. He works out the geography on air, correcting himself from Quebec to Ontario, which shows the identification being assembled rather than seen.

claim_text: A great depression coming on the area because of how the election is going, from unrighteous thinking, with corruption in the election and election fraud called out to be exposed.
quote: Corruption in the election. Corrupt elections
falsify_match: Documented fraud in the April 2025 Canadian election.
falsify_miss: No fraud was established and the result was not contested on those grounds. This was given four weeks before the vote.

claim_text: An Illuminati-style pyramid over the darkness at Toronto, with Quebec not as bad, and Vancouver trying to be its own thing and save the Canadian economy.
quote: one of those Illuminati pyramids over Toronto
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event.
falsify_miss: Not checkable.

claim_text: An earthquake with the numbers eight, then 8.0, then 8.8 and 8.7 seen, with the plates shifting deep down underneath and splitting.
quote: I see a 8.0. I see an eight. 8.8
falsify_match: A magnitude 8.7 or 8.8 earthquake in Japan.
falsify_miss: No such earthquake. Three magnitudes given in sequence is the most numerically specific earthquake telling in the corpus.

claim_text: The Japanese earthquake described as more inland than the one that hit the power plant, magnitude 8.0 plus, with the plates shifting low down and trying to divide the island mass into what looks like two Japans.
quote: it tries to divide almost like two different Japans
falsify_match: A magnitude 8 or greater inland Japanese earthquake causing a visible geographic split.
falsify_miss: No such earthquake. Inland rather than offshore is the distinguishing detail, and it is the opposite of where Japan's largest events occur.

claim_text: Prayer over all nine Supreme Court justices with two of them shown to him as being in the balance, and three others who would try to rise up and cause great confusion in the days ahead and who will be removed if they do not change.
quote: there's three that would try to rise up and cause
falsify_match: Three judges obstructing and then leaving the bench.
falsify_miss: No such departures. The numbers two and three are the checkable part, since he names nobody.

claim_text: Prayer that American intelligence break the secrets in the Iranian mountains, get past the missile systems and annihilate the weapons of mass destruction, so there will be no nuclear Iran.
quote: there will be no nuclear Iran
falsify_match: Iranian nuclear facilities destroyed.
falsify_miss: Iran retains enrichment capability. Framed as a petition, given nearly three months before the June strikes.

claim_text: Moving from Iraq to South Korea and Japan, seeing financial adoptions there, like a bottle of fizzy water shaken and waiting to pop.
quote: South Korea Japan Financial things I see it adoptions
falsify_match: South Korea and Japan adopting a financial framework ahead of others.
falsify_miss: Neither moves first. This is the earliest telling of the Asian financial adoption on file, before the Sooners wording was attached to it.

claim_text: Canada seen again with the city on the Pacific and its leadership wanting to jump in too, and chatter that if they jump in it will help, with Canada in financial trouble.
quote: the city on the Pacific the leadership there
falsify_match: Vancouver moving into a financial arrangement separate from Ottawa.
falsify_miss: No such move. The Pacific city is unnamed here and identified as Vancouver elsewhere in the same session.

claim_text: Storms seen on the east coast and now on the west coast, with beautiful areas of revival across America that will be places of refuge for the body of Christ, and a statement that he has learned not to quote time frames because it catches your hand in the door.
quote: do not quote time frames
falsify_match: Identifiable places of refuge forming as both coasts are struck.
falsify_miss: Neither. The stated policy of not quoting time frames is the single most important methodological line in the corpus, because it explains why so few claims carry dates.

claim_text: Fragmentary tongues and interpretation about getting around things and an acceleration, with plots and plans involving Iran, the Houthis and the rebels.
quote: Oh, plots and plans
falsify_match: An Iranian plot uncovered.
falsify_miss: Nothing specific is given here to check.

claim_text: Two fronts seen, one in the Middle East and one in Europe, then a third area with Israel's involvement, and Kim Jong-un's face appearing again.
quote: Two fronts. One in the Middle East. One one in in Europe
falsify_match: Simultaneous major conflicts in the Middle East and Europe with Israel as a third theatre.
falsify_miss: Conflicts stay separate and regional. Two fronts and then three is counted on air, which makes the number his rather than given.

claim_text: Iran in the mountains again with nuclear facilities hidden inside a mountain in a ridge, three mountains with the facility on the inside of the right hand one.
quote: the facility is hidden on the inside of this mountain
falsify_match: An Iranian facility inside a mountain in a three-peak ridge, on the right hand side.
falsify_miss: The description does not match a known site. This is the earliest mountain telling on file, a month before the article he later treats as confirmation. Fordow is built under a mountain and had been publicly reported since 2009.

claim_text: Iran seen as a stepchild off to the side while North Korea matters more because of its nuclear capabilities, with greater darkness there and something more dangerous and secret that they hold, and something greater being offered to them.
quote: There's something more dangerous about over here that they have
falsify_match: Disclosure of a North Korean capability beyond its known arsenal.
falsify_miss: No such disclosure. He does not say what it is, which removes the checkable part.

claim_text: Prayer that this not be a stalemate presidency, and a statement that the Russian plan runs outside the four year window and is strategic like chess to take back the old Soviet Union, with a criticism of prophets who prophesy from down in the trees out of the natural rather than the spiritual.
quote: trying to take back the old Soviet Union
falsify_match: Russian moves against further former Soviet states after 2029.
falsify_miss: No such moves. Placing the plan outside the presidential term means it cannot be scored before 2029, which he says explicitly.

claim_text: Newsom's face seen repeatedly at the California border, with Hollywood alongside it.
quote: I see Gavin Newsome's face on the California down by
falsify_match: A border-related scandal implicating the governor.
falsify_miss: No such scandal. This is the earliest telling of the Newsom border material on file, five months before the fuller version.

claim_text: The same scene repeated with Hollywood named twice and an exclamation of dismay.
quote: I see Hollywood. I see Hollywood
falsify_match: A Hollywood scandal connected to the border material.
falsify_miss: None. Repetition without added content.

claim_text: Japan seen at its southern tip with business people there, and then Los Angeles named twice as the focus.
quote: The focus is Los Angeles
falsify_match: A trafficking network centred on Los Angeles with a Japanese business connection.
falsify_miss: No such network uncovered. Japan appearing alongside Los Angeles is the unusual pairing here.

claim_text: Very dark things seen: young virgins priced higher, dark businessmen, drug lords offering money to parents with nothing to give their children, politicians involved, and the governor turning a blind eye to it in refuge cities, with the anger of the Lord and vengeance so that the rocks will not hide these men.
quote: the virgins were priced for more money
falsify_match: A trafficking prosecution reaching politicians and Californian officials.
falsify_miss: No such prosecution. He says there are darker things he cannot say on the channel, which is the same withholding pattern.
